texts: On day 259 of Year 1, Coraline Ash lit the lantern of the Harbor Station at sundown on the thirtieth night of the solo stretch.
Coraline Ash completed thirty solo nights.
Coraline Ash's solo count reached thirty.
Pell and Coraline Ash met at dawn on day 260 of Year 1.
Coraline Ash and Pell walked back to Aelmere together.
The Council met in an informal session on day 260 of Year 1.
The Council invested Coraline Ash as a Keeper.
Coraline Ash lit her first lantern as a Keeper at sundown.
Meren Tallowhand placed a hand on Coraline Ash's shoulder.
Every villager present repeated the phrase.

q1_issues.issue: (Ordinal sk_lantern_2 1 light) silently drops the stated restriction "as a Keeper", so it asserts an unrestricted rank-1 lighting that contradicts the lighting event already asserted for day 259.
(Member coraline_ash keeper) is asserted a second time — the identical content atom was already emitted at index 61 — which counts as a second piece of evidence for one proposition.

q2_gaps: a counted temporal NP as a time adjunct ("on the thirtieth night of the solo stretch"): the Time value slot is specified only for structured calendar terms and bare deictic / day-part symbols, so an interval-internal counted night has no licensed filler (the parse improvises (Time sk_light_1 sk_night_1) with an entity witness)

an ordinal restricted by a role or phase ("her first lantern as a Keeper", "the thirtieth night of the solo stretch"): Ordinal has entity / rank / scale slots only and nowhere to carry the restricting domain
the directional / restitutive adverb "back" in "walked back to Aelmere": it is neither a Manner adverb nor the Again particle, and has no licensed slot
review.notes: The collective readings for "met" and "walked ... together", the common-noun default for "the Council" (no Name atom), the invested-as-a-Keeper result-state shape, and the "every villager present" distribution rule with its QuantifierPhrase companion are all handled per the instruction set. The PartOf choices for "the lantern of the Harbor Station" and "the thirtieth night of the solo stretch" are borderline against the opaque Possession but defensible.

issues.reason: Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated restriction ("an unencodable qualifier never becomes an unqualified assertion"), and the unrestricted (Ordinal sk_lantern_2 1 light) is false against the parse's own earlier lighting by the same agent on day 259.

The identical content atom (Member coraline_ash keeper) is emitted twice (indices 61 and 71), which by the instruction set's own stated rationale counts as a second piece of evidence for one proposition and pushes its revised confidence past the mandated revisable 0.99 ceiling.

gaps_confirmed: a counted temporal NP as a Time filler ("on the thirtieth night of the solo stretch"): the Time value slot is specified only for structured calendar terms and bare deictic / day-part symbols, so an entity witness there is unlicensed

an ordinal restricted by a role or phase ("her first lantern as a Keeper", "the thirtieth night of the solo stretch"): Ordinal has entity / rank / scale slots only and no slot for the restricting domain
the directional / restitutive adverb "back" ("walked back to Aelmere"): neither a Manner adverb nor one of the four aspectual particles, so it has no licensed slot (the parse correctly leaves it out)
new_gaps: a capacity / role "as NP" adjunct on an event ("lit her first lantern as a Keeper"): the preposition-named oblique is the only open carrier, but its object-NP rule would mint a second keeper witness distinct from the subject who already bears (Member coraline_ash keeper), so there is no clean way to say "in the capacity of"

a day-of-year date term in a non-Gregorian calendar ("on day 259 of Year 1"): (Day n) is exemplified only as day-of-month alongside a Month term, so a monthless day ordinal has no stated convention and the seeded date-ordering rules key on same-year-month day
adjudication.defect_summary: For "her first lantern as a Keeper" the instruction set licenses NO compliant form — Ordinal cannot carry the "as a Keeper" domain restriction — so the compliant parse drops the Ordinal atom entirely and records that gap rather than asserting an unrestricted rank 1; for the duplicate, (Member coraline_ash keeper) must be emitted exactly once, as the flat half of the investiture resultative, with nothing further added at the later "as a Keeper" mention.
adjudication.notes: The collective "met"/"walked together" readings, the Name-less common-noun "the Council", the invested-as-a-Keeper State-result shape, and the "every villager present" distribution rule with its QuantifierPhrase companion are all correct. (Goal sk_place_1 sk_shoulder_1) for "placed a hand on ... shoulder" is a near-fit head for a surface "on" and is worth watching, but the motion-result rule does license Goal for a destination.
